authority: AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH. This record states the deterministic result of the canonical repository gate. It is an INPUT to 06-VALIDATION-REPORT.md and is never produced by the engine that renders it.
why_this_exists: 06-VALIDATION-REPORT.md previously embedded the tail of evidence/verify.log verbatim, and
04-REPOSITORY-CHANGE-REGISTER.md recorded the byte count and content hash that resulted. Two
canonical artifacts therefore carried the stdout of one historical execution on one machine.
.gitignore excludes 00-MASTER/**/evidence/, so the transcript was never in the tree: rendering a
fresh checkout produced the fail-closed NOT-CAPTURED branch instead, and the committed registers
were not the rendered fixed point the CI drift gate asserts them to be.
A validation RESULT is repository truth. An execution TRANSCRIPT is a historical observation of
one run. This record is the first; the transcript stays in the evidence archive, referenced by
identity and never by content, so running the command again moves no canonical byte.

contract.invocation: default (the opt-in --full registration stage is outside this contract)
contract.stages_digest_definition: sha256 over the newline-joined stage names this contract declares, read from verify.sh. A gate added to the contract and not to this record fails the record's own test.

evidence_reference.retention: PRESERVED. The archive is deliberately untracked by .gitignore rule 00-MASTER/**/evidence/ and is published by the CI workflow as a run artifact. It is evidence of the event, not a component of repository identity, and nothing reads it to render a canonical artifact.
